card_description: Start with local AI or a guided template. Adjust joints and skin weights, test movement, and export a rigged GLB for Blender.
card_experimental: This workflow is still in development. Check joint placement and deformation on your mesh before using the rig.

spatial_compare_mirrored_surface: Compare both sides of the mesh before applying the mirror.

title: Rig a Character
description: Build a skeleton, refine its joints and test how your mesh moves.
artwork: A friendly tin woodsman waving, with a glowing skeleton overlay on its body and arm.
no_variant: No eligible saved GLB was found.
some_history_missing: Some saved packages could not be indexed.
bound_status: Bound {bones} bones. Choose a pose to review the skin.
edit_hint: Drag a joint in front and side views to position its pivot. Shift-click to place the selected joint at its current depth.
after_export: Would you like to rig this mesh?
guided_hint: Start with an adjustable humanoid template and place its joints by hand.
ai_unavailable: Local AI requires Windows x64 and a compatible NVIDIA GPU.
ai_ready: Local AI is ready. Prediction runs on this computer.
ai_setup: First use needs about {gb} GB of available model and software downloads, plus Python and CUDA packages. Prediction runs on this computer.
summary_num_beams: Searches {value} candidate paths at each step.
summary_proxy_resolution: Proxy resolution: {value} cells along the character’s height.
invalid_custom: Enter a valid value for every custom setting.
help_num_beams: More beams search more possibilities and take longer.
help_top_k: Limits each step to its top candidates. Zero disables the limit.
help_seed: Change the seed to try a different starting fit.
help_proxy_resolution: More cells preserve finer shapes and cost more CPU time and memory.
fit_software: Preparing the local Python and CUDA environment…
fit_review: Prediction applied. Review joints in front and side views before binding.
help_fit: Fit a starting skeleton, then move its joints to the character’s pivots. Check both front and side views.
help_review: Bind the mesh to your joints, then test the poses. Return to fitting if a bend needs adjustment.
help_export: Save a separate rigged asset. Your original mesh stays in History. Open the rig in Blender for further editing.
body_rig_limit: This humanoid body rig has no individual finger or facial controls. Review deformation before production use.
tool_orbit_hint: Drag to orbit; scroll to zoom. Use Front and Side for alignment.
tool_move_hint: Click a joint to select it; drag to move it. Use both views to check depth.
tool_place_hint: Click the mesh area to place the selected joint at its current depth, then check the other view.
operation_cancelled: Cancelled. Your joints and any previous completed rig are preserved.
operation_interrupted: The operation was interrupted. Your saved joints are available; retry when ready.
place_part_tip: The chain starts at the selected bone’s tip. Place the other end, then check it from the side.
invalid_part_tip: Move the tip away from the attachment and choose 1 to 32 bones.
weight_stale: Saved strokes need a new bind. The preview shows previous weights.
weight_help: Turn on the heat map, then drag over the mesh in Rest. Radius is measured in source units and can reach nearby surfaces.
tool_select_hint: Click a joint. Click again or use [ and ] to cycle through overlapping joints.
tool_orient_hint: Drag the ring to rotate the bone’s rest axes. Check the result in Test movement.
